title: ChronoSheaf: Joint Spatio-Temporal Spectral Filtering on Cellular Sheaves
abstract: arXiv:2610.21958v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Sheaf neural networks generalize graph neural networks by assigning each edge a learned linear restriction map that specifies how the local representations of adjacent nodes relate to one another, thereby mitigating oversmoothing. Existing sheaf architectures, however, define the sheaf Laplacian as an instantaneous spatial operator and therefore cannot explicitly model how signals evolve over time on a graph. We first introduce a spectral sheaf Laplacian, defined jointly over space and time, such that a single operator regulates signal propagation across both the spatial graph and the temporal domain. Directly extending this operator's receptive field in space or time would require increasingly complex sheaf structures. Instead, we propose a spectral filter that expands the effective receptive field along both dimensions without enlarging the underlying sheaf. translated_title: ChronoSheaf：基于胞腔层束的时空联合谱滤波
translated_abstract: 层束神经网络通过为每条边分配一个可学习的线性限制映射来推广图神经网络，该映射规定了相邻节点的局部表示之间如何相互关联，从而缓解过平滑问题。然而，现有的层束架构将层束拉普拉斯算子定义为瞬时空间算子，因此无法显式建模信号在图上随时间的演化。我们首先引入了一种谱层束拉普拉斯算子，它在空间和时间上联合定义，使得单个算子即可同时调控信号在空间图和时间域上的传播。若直接在空间或时间上扩展该算子的感受野，将需要越来越复杂的层束结构。为此，我们提出了一种谱滤波器，它能够在不扩大底层层束的情况下，沿这两个维度扩展有效感受野。基于该算子，我们提出了ChronoSheaf，一个时空层束神经网络……
tldr: ChronoSheaf提出了一种在空间和时间上联合定义的谱层束拉普拉斯算子及相应谱滤波器，使层束神经网络能够显式建模图上信号随时间的演化，并在不扩大底层层束结构的情况下同时扩展空间与时间维度的有效感受野。
en_tdlr: ChronoSheaf introduces a space-time spectral sheaf Laplacian together with a spectral filter, enabling sheaf neural networks to explicitly model temporal signal evolution on graphs while expanding the effective receptive field in both space and time without enlarging the underlying sheaf structure.
